out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED PITCHER IN HANDWASHING SINK IN WAREWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: PITCHER REMOVED AND PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT DEEP FRYER AT 124-149F (15MIN).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CHICKEN DROPPED BACK INTO DEEP FRYER AND PIC RE-EDUCATED ON HOT HOLDING PRACTICES.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN SELF-SERVE OPEN COOLER: CHOCOLATE MILK AT 46F, MILK 1 AT 47F, MILK 2 AT 47F, MILK 3 AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: MILK DISPOSED OF. THIS COOLER SHOULD NOT BE USED TO STORE DAIRY PRODUCTS AS IT DOES NOT HOLD IN COLD AIR DUE TO NOT HAVING A DOOR. DO NOT USE THIS FOR DAIRY UNLESS IT CAN HOLD TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW..

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed bags of cooked chicken tenders and chicken filets being thawed in the prep sink without using running water or being thawed inside refrigeration
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process.PIC moved thawing chicken to the walk in cooler

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Insect control device does not retain the insects within the device.
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. PIC took down un approved insect control devices

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F, observed temperature was 65F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC called plumber and followed up later with EHS to verify Hot water had been fixed.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: spoons for coffee and milk being stored in unheated and standing water on the coffee counter
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS asked PIC to store utensils in a clean dry location

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for paprika were observed reused for the storage of steak seasoning
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS asked PIC to only use original containers for foods.
